subject: GCP Marketplace listing & procurement onboarding — Launchpad setup
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda.park@skydata.io>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: GCP listing + procurement intake — SkyData Launchpad

Hi Sofia,

We ran your marketplace docs by our procurement team and they'd like to kick off the formal onboarding and procurement flow for a GCP Marketplace listing. We're piloting a one-year committed capacity purchase and need to align on the sales->procure handoff, Marketplace SKU mapping for billing, and signature path for contract/PO.

Attached is a short RFP (SkyData_RFP_Dec2025.pdf) with our procurement constraints and expected timelines. High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm who will be the Redwood contact for PO / invoicing.
- Provide a recommended SKU mapping for the GCP listing (billing-friendly names and unit pricing).
- Outline the DocuSign/legal contact for a marketplace SOW or reseller addendum.
- Confirm expected go-live (we're targeting mid-Jan 2026).

Can we do a 30-min intake next week to walk procurement through the process? Karthik was cc'd to help with SKU/partner ops details.

Thanks,
Linda
Linda Park
Head of IT Procurement
SkyData Analytics

Attachment: SkyData_RFP_Dec2025.pdf (PDF, 230KB)
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
To: Linda Park <linda.park@skydata.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing + procurement intake — SkyData Launchpad

Hi Linda,

Thanks — and welcome! Happy to run the intake. I've sketched a mutual action plan (MAP) for the onboarding + procurement handoff so we can align expectations. Key milestones in the MAP:
1) Intake call & procurement Q&A (this week)
2) SKU mapping + pricing confirmation from Redwood (deliverable: sku_mapping_gcp.csv)
3) Legal review & DocuSign routing (Redwood legal -> SkyData legal)
4) PO issuance by SkyData and Marketplace go-live coordination (GCP listing activation)

I've attached a MAP template (MAP_template_v1.xlsx) and proposed owners:
- Redwood PO/invoicing contact: Sofia Ivanova (me) — I will own billing handoffs and invoicing ops.
- SKU & co-sell enablement: Karthik Iyer — will confirm SKU names and partner enablement artifacts.
- Sales & Commercial: Marissa Cole — will own commercial terms and ask for any required pricing concessions.

Proposed times for a 30-min intake: Thu 12/04 10:00-10:30 PT or Fri 12/05 09:00-09:30 PT. Which works for your team?

One quick note on marketplace flow: GCP requires SKU-level metadata that maps cleanly back to billing lines (no nested metering). If SkyData expects invoice-level PO lines, we'll coordinate the SKU mapping to match your GL setup.

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Partner Ops (GCP Marketplace) | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: MAP_template_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2025 08:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing + procurement intake — SKU mapping notes

Sofia / Marissa —

Looping in a few practical notes from the SKU side before the intake:
- I'll produce a csv with suggested SKUs and unit definitions. For committed purchases we typically create two SKUs: (1) commit_reservation_hourly and (2) overage_on_demand. That maps well to PO lines for committed capacity.
- Pricing cadence: give us target ARR or committed spend (range) so we can recommend tiered per-unit pricing.
- Marketplace billing: GCP issues invoices; we map Redwood revenue recognition on our end. If SkyData needs Redwood to issue a separate invoice, we'll need a reseller arrangement; that's feasible but will add a week to legal review.
- Co-sell checkbox: If SkyData wants co-sell enablement, we will request a partner referral form and schedule an enablement call with GCP. That requires a short partner packet (we can have that ready by EOD 12/05).

I'll attach the initial sku_mapping_gcp.csv stub — it's a skeleton to help SkyData fill in expected GL codes.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: sku_mapping_gcp.csv (CSV, 3KB)
From: Linda Park <linda.park@skydata.io>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: procure@skydata.io
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2025 10:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing + procurement intake — SkyData replies

Hi Sofia, Karthik —

Thanks for the quick responses and the MAP template. A few answers from procurement:
- Target commit: $180k USD annual (we can split into quarterly PO lines).
- Preferred PO granularity: quarterly POs mapped to two SKU lines (reservation + overage). We've attached our procurement checklist (procurement_checklist_SkyData.pdf) for required fields.
- We prefer DocuSign routing: SkyData legal (legal@skydata.io) should be signature path after Redwood sends the marketplace SOW/reseller addendum.
- Security/compliance: they'll run a light security intake (SOC2 evidence) — can Redwood provide the SOC2 letter and our auditor contact? We may need the security pack before PO issuance.

We can do the intake on Thu 12/11 10:00-10:30 PT (would prefer next week due to internal schedules). If that works, please send a calendar invite.

Best,
Linda

Attachment: procurement_checklist_SkyData.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Linda —

Thanks — Thu 12/11 10:00 PT is confirmed. I sent a calendar invite and included a short pre-read folder with the MAP (MAP_template_v1.xlsx) and our SOC2 cover letter. Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B1-example-onboarding-docs.

Action items before the call:
- Redwood: finalize sku_mapping_gcp.csv with tiered pricing (Karthik — can you share EOD 12/10?).
- SkyData: confirm which GL codes (quarterly PO lines) you want populated in the sku_mapping file.
- Legal/DocuSign: Redwood legal will prepare a marketplace addendum draft and route via DocuSign to legal@skydata.io after the intake.
- Security: attaching SOC2 cover letter now (in Drive pre-read). If procurement needs the full report, we'll arrange an auditor upload link.

Looking forward to the kickoff. I'll own the PO/invoicing handoff and will remain the single point of contact for billing ops.

—Sofia
